instruction: In the essay document "Recruitment_and_retention_of_health_professionals_across_Europe.docx" located in /home/user, use the Find & Replace function to replace all occurrences of the word "European" with "EU". Save the modified document.

metadata.explanation: Task requires using Find & Replace to change all occurrences of 'European' to 'EU' and saving the document. The evaluator verifies: 1) 'European' no longer appears (count = 0), 2) 'EU' replacements are present (count >= 20), 3) document was saved. Text is extracted from all elements: paragraphs, tables, headers, footers. Original document contains 27 occurrences of 'European' that should be replaced.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Weighted scoring: 0.4 for 'European' count = 0, 0.4 for 'EU' count >= 20, 0.2 for document saved. Full score (1.0) if all conditions met.

llm_judge_reasons: Coverage is complete: Evaluator checks all 3 requirements - 'European' removed (40% weight), 'EU' added (40% weight), and document saved (20% weight)
Text extraction is comprehensive: Getter extracts from paragraphs, tables, headers, and footers (lines 39-66 in getter), covering all major document elements
Weighted scoring provides fair partial credit: 40% for replacement removal, 40% for new text presence, 20% for save action

Minor issue - Save verification is weak: Line 76 checks 'len(docx_bytes) > 0' which only verifies file exists with content, not that it was actually saved after modification. The file would pass this check even without user saving because it was downloaded initially.
Minor issue - EU count threshold imprecise: Uses '>= 20' to verify replacements, but this could pass if document already had 20+ 'EU' instances before replacement. Doesn't verify the delta/increase.

Minor issue - Case sensitivity: Uses case-insensitive counting which may not match actual Find & Replace behavior if user used case-sensitive mode, though this matches the default Find & Replace behavior in most editors
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve save verification: Compare file modification timestamp before/after task execution, or compute checksum/hash of original vs current file to verify actual modification occurred

Refine EU count logic: Instead of absolute threshold '>= 20', calculate expected increase (27 replacements) and verify EU count increased by approximately that amount, with tolerance for pre-existing EU instances
Optional: Add case-sensitive verification mode or document the assumption that case-insensitive counting matches Find & Replace default behavior
